name: story-forge
description: Turn existing text, retellings, or new fanfiction into rich-structured reading sites. Adds source ingestion (txt/epub/docx/html/pdf), project status, content audit, quantitative style metrics, source provenance/search workflow, arbitrary variants, volumes, event timeline, glossary, entity mention index, and graph path finding, alongside the original/retold modes, dossiers, relationship graph, recaps, evidence links, anti-spoiler, and locally hosted illustrations.
